nl: Who was Дьяків Сава Федорович?
steps: assistant: I'm sorry, I cannot generate an answer as there are no relevant sources available to identify who "Дьяків Сава Федорович" is. Please provide more context or information.

user: Chatbot
Who was Дьяків Сава Федорович?
As an AI language model, I do not have access to all the information about Дьяків Сава Федорович. Please provide more context or information about this person to help me provide a better answer.
Well, I know that there is an article about Дьяків Сава Федорович from https://uk.wikipedia.org/wiki/Дьяків_Сава_Федорович, and what is this article (in addition to the article about Дьяків Сава Федорович, there is an article written together with the source of this article) «Дьяків Сава Федорович, (? 1887 — 13 грудня 1919, село Іванівка Кагарлицького району Київської області (село Янівка Ставинської волості Київського повіту)) — учасник визвольних змагань Українського народу, військовий та громадський діяч Української народної республіки та Директорії, отаман осередку Вільного козацтва на Кагарличчині під час визвольної боротьби Українського народу у 1917—1919 роках, неформальний очільник місцевої влади (за відсутності та змінності останньої) Ставинської волості, організатор спротиву селян Кагарличчини (селянської війни) пограбуванням під виглядом реквизицій та мобілізацій зі сторони радянської влади та денікинців у 1918—1919 роках.

Як придатного до військової служби мобілізували на початку Першої Світової війни до Російського Флоту Його Імператорської Величності. Службу проходив на Балтійському флоті. Декілька разів ходив у далекі походи, мав нагороди Російської Імперії (не збереглися).

На початку 1917 року повернувся до рідного села Янівки, взяв активну участь у встановлені влади Центральної Ради Української Народної Республіки у Ставинській волості.

За спогадами Марко Шляхового-Кармелюка «Отаман Дьяків — мав од роду років 29 — 30, величезного росту козак і ходив завше у козацькому — чорноморського козака катеринівських часів — вбранні. Батько його був бідний селянин. З початку революції 1917 року Дьяків, перебуваючи на морській флотській службі російської армії, брав участь в українських військових організаціях Чорноморської фльоти. Коли Чорноморська фльота, як і другі, стали під кінець 1917 року більшовичитись, Дьяків кинув фльоту і самовільно прибув до Центральної Ради. Тут в часи бійки Центральної Ради з більшовиками в січні 1918 року, Дьяків був вже вільним козаком. З того часу у своєму районі на Київщині став отаманом Вільного Козацтва. Як казав мені сам Дьяков, він так любив Центральну Раду і тодішніх її проводирів, що завжди був готовий віддати своє життя в боротьбі з її ворогами, а особливо з московським чорносотенним большевизмом, в початкові боротьбі з яким він, Дьяків, і загартував свою козацьку відвагу»(Марко Шляховий-Кармелюк неточно навів дані по нього щодо служби на флоті).

Однодумець отамана Зеленого (Данила Терпила) у питанні державності та, одночасно, опонент щодо засобів досягнення мети, організував йому спротив проти накладення «реквізицій» на місцеве населення Кагарлика наприкінці 1918 року.

У серпні-вересні 1919 року розгромив осередок радянської влади у волосному містечку Германівка Київського повіту, якою за влади більшовиків у Києві протягом 1919 року організовувалися збройне пограбування (вилучення зерна, борошна та іншої їжі) селян найближчих волостей за завданням проросійського уряду Української радянської соціалістичної республіки.

Дружина Ганна Олексіївна, діти: Павло, Петро, Віра та Марія.

Ніколи не мав сина Якова, з посиланням на свідчення якого Саві Дьякові приписують участь у загибелі отамана Зеленого. За свідченнями у 2011 році його доньки Марії (мешкала у тій же самій хаті, в якій жила сім’я Сави Дьякова у 1919 році, в селі Янівка) під час загибелі отамана Зеленого знаходився у містечку Стави Київського повіту, отримавши доповідь про його загибель, вирушив із власним загоном до загону отамана Зеленого для з’ясування обставин загибелі та визначення подальших дій.

Зраджений місцевим селянином із села Янівка, який звернувся до Сави Дьякова за захистом від пограбування денікінцями цукрового заводу в Узині та вивів його 13 грудня 1919 року з невеликим загоном до засідки біля волосного містечка Мирівка Київського повіту, де Сава Дьяків загинув у бою.

Над тілом поглумилися: денікінці його тіло повісили за ноги на базарному стовпі в Мирівці для залякування населення.

steps:
assistant: The passage you're asking about explains a fundamental concept in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), focusing on how a convolution operates for a single pixel in the layer that follows. In simpler terms, it's describing the process of applying a filter (or kernel) to an input image to produce an output feature map. Let's break it down into more understandable parts.
  
1. **Convolution Operation (***):** This is a mathematical operation used in CNNs to extract features from input data. It involves a filter or kernel, which is essentially a small matrix of weights. This filter is slid (convolved) over the input image (or the previous layer's feature map) to produce a transformed version of the input. This process helps in capturing spatial dependencies in the image such as edges, textures, or patterns depending on the filter.

2. **Input Image (x):** This is the data that the CNN processes. Initially, it is the actual image you want the network to learn from, represented in a numerical form (a matrix of pixel values). In deeper layers, the input would be the output feature maps from the previous layers.

3. **Kernel or Filter Matrix (w):** This is a predefined or learned matrix that decides how to transform the input data. The kernel moves over the input image, and at every position, it applies a convolution operation. The kernel has its own small set of weights, which are optimized during the training process to capture specific features at higher efficiencies.

4. **Output in the Next Layer ():** After applying the convolution operation across the entire input image (or preceding layer's output), the result is a new feature map. This feature map represents a transformed version of the input, highlighting or suppressing specific features according to the kernel's design.

5. **How the Convolution Works:** For any given point (pixel) on the output feature map, its value is determined by overlaying the kernel on the input image (or preceding layer's feature map) such that the corresponding pixel is at the center of the kernel. Each element of the kernel is then multiplied by the value of the input element it covers, and all these products are summed up to give a single number. This sum forms one element of the output feature map.

In essence, the convolutional layer acts as a feature detector, mapping specific features from the input to the output through a combination of weighted sums determined by the overlay of the kernel on the input. These features become more complex and abstract as you go deeper into the network, enabling it to learn intricate patterns in the data.

    1. Overlaying the kernel \(w\) on top of the image \(x\) such that the kernel is centered over each pixel (or element) of \(x\) one at a time.
    
    2. Multiplying each element of \(w\) by the corresponding element of \(x\) it covers.
    
    3. Summing all these product values together to get a single output value \(y\).

\[y(i, j) = \sum_m \sum_n x(i+m, j+n) \cdot w(m, n)\]

where \(m\) and \(n\) iterate over the rows and columns of the kernel \(w\), respectively. This formula calculates the output value \(y(i, j)\) by multiplying each element of \(x\) within the region of interest by the corresponding weight in \(w\) and summing these products.

The surgical treatment of wounds can be classified into primary and secondary closure. This method is preferred for clean, non-infected wounds to promote faster healing and reduce the risk of infection.

Secondary closure, on the other hand, involves allowing a wound to heal naturally over time without immediate closure. This method is typically used for contaminated or infected wounds, as well as wounds with high risk of complications. Secondary closure allows for better drainage of wound exudates and helps prevent the formation of abscesses.

Drainage of wounds and cavities is an important aspect of wound care, especially in cases of infected or deep wounds. Drainage helps to remove excess fluid, pus, and debris from the wound, which can promote healing and prevent the formation of abscesses. There are several methods of drainage that can be used, including:

1. Passive drainage: involves the use of dressings or tubes to allow fluid to passively drain from the wound.

2. Active drainage: involves the use of suction devices or negative pressure wound therapy to actively remove fluid from the wound.

3. Surgical drainage: involves the placement of surgical drains or tubes to help remove fluid and debris from deep wounds or cavities.

Proper wound drainage is essential for preventing infection, reducing pain and discomfort, and promoting the healing of the wound. It is important to follow the recommendations of healthcare professionals and to keep the wound clean and properly dressed to ensure optimal outcomes.

- Monitoring for signs of infection and other complications.
- Allowing the wound to heal from the bottom up, with the formation of granulation tissue and eventual closure by epithelialization.

The rumble of excitable chatter blended with the crisp air of the sports field as Lucia watched St. Hilda's senior team lining up against their fierce rivals, the ladies of Mountford High. A fresh girl at St. Hilda’s, Lucia was still adjusting to the culture shock—her prior school never would have sanctioned such an unabashedly muddy affair as a rugby match.

The kit was tough and practical, if considerably cleaner than it would be in an hour’s time.

The whistle blew, and the teams erupted into a whirl of motion. Lucia watched intently as the Mountford winger made a break, sprinting with the ball tucked under her arm. "Watch number seven, that's Elizabeth," Sophie said.

With the grace of a gazelle and the ferocity of a lioness, Elizabeth cornered her. Mud flung from their boots as they collided with a squelch, and the Mountford girl went down, the ball slipping free. It was more elegant than any dance Lucia had seen, their bodies coated with a fresh splatter of earthy brown.

The game didn't let up, the ball transferring sides, laughter and grunts intermingling. The crowd cheered as St. Hilda's scrum-half dug her boots into the muddied grass for leverage, passing a slick, wet ball to the fly-half who broke through the line, her shirt catching more and more mud, badges of honor in this ferocious game.

Lucia marveled at the sight; these were the same girls who walked the halls with such composure, now throwing themselves into tackles without a care. Pretty faces were smeared with mud, and golden locks were matted, yet their spirit never dimmed; it seemed to brighten.

When St. Hilda’s prop, a stocky girl with a reputation for the best tackles, caught a Mountford forward square in the chest, they both tumbled to the ground. Rising, their kits were caked, turning their emerald greens almost black, but their grins were undimmed.

One last shove sent the opposing team reeling, and the ball was grounded over the line. A roar went up from the St. Hilda's side.

"They scored a try!" Sophie shouted over the noise, and Lucia clapped, feeling a surge of school pride. The conversion kick that followed bent perfectly through the air, sailing over the bar, despite the kicker's mud-slicked boots.

Sophie turned to Lucia, eyes sparkling. "See, it's not about staying clean or looking perfect. It's about playing with all you've got, for the team, for the fun. It's rugby."

As the match drew to a close, Lucia reflected on the players. Once impeccably neat, they were now unrecognizable statues of mud, glorious in their disarray. The final whistle blew, signaling the end of the game. St. Hilda's had won, but more than that, they had shown Lucia the true spirit of their school. As the girls shook hands with their opponents, murky water squelching beneath their boots, Lucia promised herself she'd join them soon, unafraid to get her hands—and everything else—covered in mud.

assistant: The question of whether nature is art can be subjective and depend on one's perspective and interpretation of what constitutes art. There are compelling arguments for both supporting and rejecting the idea that nature is art.

Those who argue that nature is art often point to the following reasons:

1. Aesthetic qualities: Nature is characterized by an abundance of beautiful and striking patterns, forms, and colors. From the intricate design of a snowflake to the vibrant hues of a sunset, many aspects of nature can evoke a strong emotional response and appreciation similar to the experience of viewing a piece of art.

2. Inspirational source: Throughout history, numerous artists have drawn inspiration from nature in their work. Landscapes, wildlife, and natural phenomena have been central themes in various artistic disciplines, ranging from visual arts to literature and music. The ability of nature to inspire creativity, imagination, and emotion can make a case for considering it a form of art.

On the other hand, some may argue that nature is not art, for these reasons:

1. Intent: Art is often seen as a product of human intention, expression, and creativity. Since nature is not consciously created by a person seeking to convey a message, communicate emotions, or evoke a reaction, it may not fulfill the criteria of what constitutes art from the human perspective.

2. Authorship: Nature may not have an "author" or "creator" in the same way that human-made art does. Art typically reflects an individual's or group's intentions, motivations, or cultural backgrounds. Nature, however, does not possess these same characteristics since it develops through natural phenomena and processes outside human control.

In summary, whether nature is considered art depends on the individual's belief and framework for understanding art. While nature possesses aesthetic qualities and serves as an inspiration for human-made art, it lacks the intent, expression, and authorship associated with traditional art forms. Ultimately, the categorization of nature as art is a matter of personal perspective and interpretation.

assistant: Yes, stable diffusion refers to a type of machine learning model that's designed to generate or modify images in a controlled manner. These models are a subset of generative adversarial networks (GANs), which consist of two parts: a generator that creates images, and a discriminator that evaluates their realism. The "stable" element typically indicates that the training process has been managed in a way to avoid common problems like mode collapse (where the generator produces a limited variety of outputs).

When it comes to producing realistic outputs with such models, prompt engineering or prompt crafting is a critical skill. It involves writing the textual input or commands that guide the AI in generating images that align with your desired outcome. Here are some general guidelines for writing effective prompts:

1. **Be Specific:** Provide detailed descriptions, the more specific you are about what you want, the better the model can satisfy your request. Include details like the setting, subject's appearance, time of day, lighting, mood, artistic style, and so on.

2. **Use References:** When aiming for a certain style or referencing a specific artist, mention them by name or describe the characteristic features of their work. This can guide the model to emulate those styles.

3. **Control the Complexity:** The more complex your prompt, the harder it is for the model to generate a good result. Start simple and then iterate, adding complexity incrementally if needed.

4. **Iterate and Refine:** Often, you won't get the perfect result on the first try. Generate multiple images and refine your prompt based on the output until you get closer to your desired result.

5. **Understand Your Model:** Different models may be trained on different datasets or optimized for different tasks. Knowing what your particular model excels at can help tailor your prompts for better results.

6. **Use Modifiers:** Adjectives play a crucial role in describing the quality or characteristics of the subject. Words like "photorealistic," "high-resolution," "detailed," "vibrant," etc., can influence the outcome significantly.

7. **Mind the Language:** The language model that interprets your prompt can have quirks. Certain phrases or words may be interpreted in unexpected ways. It may take trial and error to understand how your language influences the results.

8. **Experiment:** Sometimes, unexpected combinations of words and descriptions can lead to impressive results. Don't be afraid to try outlandish or non-intuitive prompts.

9. **Leverage Prompt Communities:** Various communities online share prompts and their resulting images, which can be a valuable resource for learning what works and what doesn't.

Remember that what works for one generation model might not work as well for another since it heavily depends on how the model was trained and the data it was trained on. Also, as AI tools and models evolve, these approaches might need adaptation to stay current.

steps:
assistant: Title: A Day in Marco's Shoes

Chapter 1: Accidental Transformation

My name’s Tyler, a college sophomore with a penchant for skateboards and punk rock bands. My roommate, Marco? He’s like a walking, talking Italian brand - suave with his slicked-back black hair, a neat little goatee, always dressed to impress, and his piercing brown eyes resembled someone out of a Renaissance painting. He was the pinnacle of European flair, while I was more 'hit the beach at dawn, attend class if I wake up in time'.

Life took a peculiar twist one Monday when Marco's grandmother fell ill—nothing too serious, but enough to send him hustling back to Italy for a week. With a friendly slap on the back and a "Ciao, bro," he left me alone in the dorm.

In less than 24 hours, my world would flip upside down. It started with spilling coffee on my white tee and only having Marco's fitted crimson polo unscathed in the room. Then, trying to fix my blonde, messy mop with hair product I grabbed blindly, it darkened considerably, reacting absurdly to whatever that Italian concoction was. My sketchy attempt at a hair flip turned into a sleek back nearly identical to Marco's. 

While fiddling with hair gel, my earring snagged on my sleeve, tearing through - the pain was searing. I sought refuge in the restroom, where a splash of water from the leaky faucet sprayed directly onto my chinos. It was just my luck that the only pants available were Marco's tailored slacks.

Chapter 2: An Unanticipated Masquerade

As if things couldn't get worse, I stumbled into a campus event in the art department - amateur henna tattoo artistry. Before I knew what was happening, a girl insisted on using my face for a demonstration, drawing a goatee perfectly mirroring Marco's. Of course, it was not to wash off for weeks.

A desperate trip to return to the sanctuary of my dorm room ended in disaster as I realized my keys were missing. Frantically checking pockets, I found a vial of cologne - Marco's signature scent. In a fidgety reflex, I drenched myself. I was now a close smelly replica of my roommate.

Then came the shoes. Those cursed Italian leather shoes Marco treated like gold. They were a size too small for me, but in my panic to find my keys, I jammed my feet into them anyway. Limping down the hallway with my belongings, minus the keys, I looked nothing like myself.

Chapter 3: The Impromptu Role

That's when I was recognized, or rather, misrecognized. Marco's friends, a vibrant group of Italian exchange students, spotted me. "Marco!" they cheered, none the wiser. I tried to protest, but they whisked me away, chatting about the Calcio game last night and their plans for pizza.

Surviving the day was a matter of nodding and throwing in an occasional "Sì" or "Certo". The Italian accent I attempted was something of a cross between a bad gangster movie and a pasta commercial, but they bought it. Marco's life was now mine, complete with soccer trivia and debates over the best way to cook pasta al dente.

Chapter 4: An Uncomfortable Evening

Nightfall didn't bring relief. Stuck in Marco's persona, I was compelled to follow the gang, all the way into one of their dorm rooms. They continued with their lively conversations in rapid Italian, filled with gesticulations and passionate exclamations. I was stuck, trying to keep up, praying for sleep and the end of this peculiar nightmare.

The bed I was to sleep on was foreign, the night was long and uncomfortable. Laying in the darkness, I thought about how a day could go so astonishingly wrong and how I'd never have guessed I'd spend the night living a life that was so emphatically not mine.

Chapter 5: Dawn of Truth

The following morning, Marco’s friends had left early for class, and I had a chance to limp back to my own room. Our RA had a master key and let me in, eyeing me skeptically as I stumbled past him.

When I finally looked into the mirror, the reflection solidified the ridiculousness of the past day. Marco returned later, to find his room a mess and his roommate with an inexplicable Italianate appearance. Explaining everything was as painful as the cramps in my feet from his shoes.

That was the day I learned valuable life lessons: never use unidentified hair products, always carry spare keys, and under no circumstances ever sleep in another man’s bed, especially if his name is Marco and his Italian entourage can't tell the difference.

steps:
assistant: When writing a cease and desist letter, it's important to be clear, concise, and professional. Here are the steps to follow:

1. Begin with a formal introduction: Start the letter with your name, address, and contact information. Make sure to include a formal salutation, such as "Dear [Recipient's Name]."

2. Clearly state your purpose: In the first paragraph, clearly state that the recipient must immediately cease and desist from a specific activity. Be specific about what they are doing wrong and how it violates your rights.

3. Provide detailed evidence: In the following paragraph(s), present evidence supporting your claim. This could include photographs, screenshots, or any relevant documents to establish proof of their actions.

4. Reference relevant laws or regulations: If applicable, reference specific laws or regulations that the recipient is violating. This helps strengthen your argument and demonstrates that you have a legal basis for your request.

5. Explain the consequences: In the next section, explain the consequences the recipient may face if they fail to comply with your request. This could include legal action, injunctions, or seeking monetary compensation. However, avoid making any threats or false claims.

6. State a deadline: Specify a reasonable deadline by which the recipient must cease and desist from the specified activity. Ensure that you provide an appropriate timeframe to allow them to comply.

7. Demand a written response: Request a written response confirming their compliance within the given deadline. This will help maintain a record of your efforts to resolve the issue amicably.

8. Closing and contact information: Close the letter with a polite and professional ending, such as "Sincerely" or "Yours faithfully." Sign the letter and include your contact information again (email address, phone number, and mailing address).

9. Retain a copy: Make copies of the letter for your records before sending it. It's important to have a documented record of your communication.

10. Send the letter via certified mail: Send the cease and desist letter via certified mail with a return receipt requested. This ensures that you have proof of delivery and receipt.

Remember, it's always a good idea to seek legal advice before sending a cease and desist letter, especially if the matter involves complex legal issues.

assistant: In a bustling eatery nestled within the heart of a reimagined London, two figures stood out among the crowd. One was a mountain of a woman with an iconic pink mane, while the other bore a spiky brown hairdo and a jacket displaying bright orange patches. These were none other than Zarya and Tracer, or at least, patrons would have believed so at first glance. However, this lunch was about to reveal more than what met the eye.

They sat opposite each other at a small, circular table, half-eaten sandwiches forgotten as their conversation took an intriguing turn.

"How does the Zarya costume feel?" Tracer asked playfully, an impish twinkle in her eye.

Zarya's broad hands moved to her face, patting it as if testing the texture. "Feels fine to me," she responded, her voice deep but with a curious lilt. With a grin, she turned the question around. "And how about the Tracer costume? Looks a tad snug from here."

Tracer pulled at her cheeks, and with a comical 'boing,' they snapped back into place. "It's a bit tight around the jowls, but I'll manage," she chuckled. Adjusting her bomber jacket, she added, "You're doing rather well, squeezing such a muscular body into such a small suit!"

Zarya's smirk widened, and her blue eyes sparkled with mirth. "The wonders of modern costuming," she quipped.

The two faux heroes continued their banter for a while, amusing each other with the oddities of dressing up as one another. Yet as the hands of the clock spun, both felt the constriction of their elaborate disguises grow wearisome.

"Alright, comrade, I think it's time to get out of these," Zarya declared, standing up with a stretch that threatened to pop seams. She turned her broad back to her companion. "Lend a hand with the zip?"

Tracer stood and approached 'Zarya,' her fingers delving into the thick pink mane until they apprehended the concealed zipper. With a decisive yank, the back split wide open, baring the intricacies of an impressive suit—skin, muscles, and all. "Voila!"

"Cheers, luv," 'Zarya' thanked her with a familiar British lilt as she reached up to her face. In a swift motion, the stoic facade was peeled away to reveal the real Tracer—her features sharp and her eyes alight with the freedom of unmasking. Stepping out of the Zarya suit, she shook out her limbs, her own jacket crinkling comfortably around her.

"Now, it's your turn," she said, a knowing smile curving her lips.

The 'Tracer' looked apprehensively at her for a moment before beginning the process of shedding her costume—goggles, chrono accelerator, and arm holsters fell to the table in rapid succession. Finally, she slipped off her jacket and turned her back to reveal a hidden zipper amidst the iconic blue armor.

Tracer's hands made quick work of the zip, and like the shedding of a second skin, the Tracer costume was released. The real Zarya emerged, her physique instantly filling the space the small suit had previously constrained. She flexed her biceps with relief, malleable facial features returning to their resolute, familiar form.

Together, they sighed in unison—a symphony of release—and Tracer couldn't help but laugh. "Fancy another go at fooling the world with our costumes?"

Zarya grinned, rolling her shoulders back. "Perhaps next year, little one. But next time, I pick the costumes."

They shared a comradely nod, their laughter mingling with the ambient noises of the eatery as they settled back into their true selves, reminiscing about the bewildered looks they'd soon leave in their wake.

Title: The Rich Tapestry of Mathematical History

Introduction

Mathematics, often referred to as the "queen of the sciences," has a rich and fascinating history that spans thousands of years. From the ancient civilizations of Egypt and Mesopotamia to the cutting-edge developments of modern mathematics, this essay will explore the captivating journey of mathematical ideas, concepts, and discoveries that have shaped our world. It is a story of human curiosity, intellect, and ingenuity, demonstrating how mathematics has evolved from basic counting methods to become a cornerstone of science, technology, and civilization.

I. Ancient Beginnings

The origins of mathematics can be traced back to ancient civilizations. The Egyptians, around 3000 BCE, developed a system of arithmetic for practical purposes like measuring land and building structures. Similarly, the Sumerians of Mesopotamia created a system of writing and numerals around 3400 BCE, which included the earliest recorded instance of the base-60 system. These early mathematical developments laid the foundation for more complex mathematical concepts.

II. Greek Mathematics

The ancient Greeks, particularly the likes of Pythagoras, Euclid, and Archimedes, made significant contributions to mathematics around 600-300 BCE. Pythagoras' theorem, which relates the sides of a right triangle, is a classic example. Euclid's "Elements" stands as one of the most influential mathematical texts in history, outlining the principles of geometry. Archimedes, renowned for his innovations in geometry and calculus, made discoveries that are still studied today.

III. The Middle Ages and Islamic Mathematics

During the Middle Ages, mathematical progress continued in the Islamic world. Scholars like Al-Khwarizmi laid the groundwork for algebra, with the term "algebra" itself derived from his work "Al-Kitab al-Mukhtasar fi Hisab al-Jabr wal-Muqabala." The word "algorithm" is also named after him. The Islamic world preserved and expanded upon Greek and Indian mathematical knowledge, which would later be reintroduced to Europe.

IV. The Renaissance and the Scientific Revolution

The Renaissance period in Europe saw a resurgence of interest in mathematics. Figures like Leonardo da Vinci applied mathematical principles to art and science. However, it was during the Scientific Revolution, from the 16th to the 18th century, that mathematics truly flourished. Pioneers like Johannes Kepler, Galileo Galilei, and Sir Isaac Newton used mathematics to describe and explain natural phenomena, laying the groundwork for modern physics.

V. The 19th and 20th Centuries

The 19th and 20th centuries witnessed unprecedented growth in mathematics. Karl Friedrich Gauss made groundbreaking contributions to number theory, while Georg Cantor revolutionized our understanding of infinity with set theory. Albert Einstein's theory of relativity relied heavily on non-Euclidean geometry developed by mathematician Bernhard Riemann. Meanwhile, the development of computers led to the birth of computational mathematics and the exploration of complex algorithms.

VI. Contemporary Mathematics

In the 21st century, mathematics continues to evolve at an astonishing pace. Fields like cryptography, data science, and machine learning rely on advanced mathematical concepts. The exploration of prime numbers, the ongoing quest for a unifying theory of everything in physics, and the pursuit of solving complex mathematical conjectures like the Riemann Hypothesis showcase the depth and breadth of contemporary mathematical research.

Conclusion

The history of mathematics is a testament to human curiosity, innovation, and the relentless pursuit of understanding the world around us. From humble beginnings in ancient civilizations to the frontiers of modern research, mathematics has been an indispensable tool in shaping our society and advancing our knowledge. As we look to the future, we can only imagine the exciting mathematical discoveries that await, continuing this captivating journey through the annals of human history.

Introduction

The global business environment is becoming increasingly competitive, necessitating multinational enterprises (MNEs) to strategically expand their international footprint in order to maintain and strengthen their competitive advantage (Chen & Hsu, 2019). In order to achieve this objective, ExxonMobil, a well-known energy and gas company, is attempting to internationalize its operations in Sudan. The company's history of successful expansion into countries such as Nigeria and Qatar (ExxonMobil, 2023) demonstrates its strategic capability in leveraging internationalisation theories (e.g., Dunning's Eclectic Theory and Monopolistic Advantage Theory) and frameworks (e.g., Porter's Diamond Model) (Rugman & Verbeke, 2001). This report will delve deeper into the strategic means by which ExxonMobil can realize its internationalization initiative in Sudan, based on a comprehensive analysis of the business environment and strategic alternatives.

ExxonMobil would gain a competitive advantage on the global market by gaining access to untapped oil and gas reserves by expanding into Sudan. Applying Dunning's Eclectic Theory (1980) to ExxonMobil's current internationalization initiatives, it is clear that the company's ownership advantages (e.g. proprietary technologies), location advantages (e.g. access to natural resources), and internalization advantages (e.g. vertical integration) can be successfully extended to the Sudanese market. Additionally, internationalization has the potential to diversify ExxonMobil's revenue streams, optimize resource allocation, and create synergistic benefits with the host nation (Ricardo, 1817).

This report examines the various layers of Sudan's business environment, address plausible strategic options, and suggest an appropriate strategy implementation method. In doing so, the report will demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of ExxonMobil's internationalisation efforts and their potential implications for the Sudanese market, allowing for well-informed decisions regarding the company's strategic trajectory.



SITUATION ANALYSIS

Macro Environment

Political Factors: The political landscape of Sudan is intricate and challenging for multinational corporations, particularly those in the oil and gas industry. While South Sudan's independence in 2011 resulted in the division of hydrocarbon resources, the ongoing conflicts in South Kordofan and Blue Nile states, as well as the Darfur region, pose a significant threat to stability (Doyle & Sandle, 2012). In addition, Sudan has been subject to a variety of international sanctions as a result of the government's alleged involvement in human rights violations, including U.S. sanctions that were lifted in 2017 (Sudan Tribune, 2017; Blanchard, 2020). ExxonMobil must be aware of the political situation, assure compliance with any remaining sanctions, and lobby for the support of key Sudanese government players.

Economic Factors: Sudan's economy has suffered from high inflation, trade deficits, and currency devaluations in recent years, but since the termination of U.S. sanctions, economic diversification has improved and foreign investment has increased (Ramadan & Holmes, 2019; Zuienker, 2020). The oil industry is a significant contributor to Sudan's gross domestic product, and the country is eager to reverse the decline in output (Raslan, 2018). This presents ExxonMobil with a potentially lucrative business opportunity, but the economic instability and potential foreign exchange risk must be carefully considered.

Social Factors: Approximately 70% of the population is Muslim, 20% adheres to traditional African beliefs, and 10% follows Christianity (CIA World Factbook, 2021). The country has a history of ethnic conflict and strained relations between various groups, as well as greater rates of illiteracy and inadequate access to education and healthcare (Osman, 2020). ExxonMobil can earn goodwill and promote social stability by employing a culturally sensitive approach and investing in local community development programs.

Technological Factors: The global transition toward clean and renewable energy sources will have an effect on Sudan's oil and gas market, as will advances in technologies that promote energy efficiency, such as IoT, automation, and data analytics (Terlouw & Vliet, 2021; Sovacool et al., 2020). Moreover, the country's transportation and energy distribution infrastructures are inadequate (AfDB, 2020). ExxonMobil can capitalize on these trends by incorporating cutting-edge technologies and collaborating with local governments to enhance infrastructure.

Legal Factors: The legal framework for Sudan's oil and gas exploration and production is undergoing changes to attract foreign investment, but challenges remain, particularly regarding unclear regulations and a lack of transparency (Elhaj, 2018; Ramin, 2020). ExxonMobil must conduct exhaustive due diligence and engage local legal expertise to navigate this environment.

Environmental Factors: Sudan's oil production has been criticized for its impact on the environment, specifically in relation to water contamination and deforestation (Lehmacher & Boute, 2021). International NGOs and environmental lobbying groups are likely to devote more attention to these issues. ExxonMobil must strive to reduce its environmental impact by adopting eco-friendly technologies and standards and by collaborating closely with local stakeholders to guarantee regulatory compliance.

Five Forces Analysis of the Oil and Gas Industry in Sudan

Threat of new entrants: While entry barriers for oil and gas exploration and production are typically high in terms of capital, technical expertise, and access to resources, recent changes to Sudan's legal environment to encourage foreign investment have reduced these barriers (Ramin, 2021). Nonetheless, ExxonMobil's extensive experience, resources, and global recognition enable it to be a formidable market competitor.

Bargaining power of suppliers: The oil industry in Sudan is dominated by a handful of large state-owned companies (e.g., Sudapet and Sudapak), giving them some leverage over suppliers (Jeory, 2020). However, the anticipated changes in the regulatory environment may attract new suppliers, thereby increasing their potential bargaining power.

Bargaining power of buyers: The principal clients are global markets and state-owned or multinational oil refining and distribution corporations (Raslan, 2018). Oil prices and demand fluctuate frequently; however, ExxonMobil's extensive global reach can assist in securing lucrative contracts.

Threat of substitutes: With increasing global demand for renewable energy sources and the ongoing transition to healthier energy, the oil and gas industry faces a significant threat from substitutes (Terlouw & Vliet, 2021). ExxonMobil must consider integrating sustainable energy production methods into its business model in order to mitigate this risk.

Competitive rivalry: Sudan's oil and gas industry has attracted multinational corporations such as Petronas, ONGC Videsh, and CNPC, intensifying competition (Jeory, 2020). This requires an exhaustive analysis of the competition and a strategy that capitalizes on ExxonMobil's unique assets and value proposition.

Barney (1991) suggests that the VRIO framework can be used to assess the extent to which these resources contribute to a sustainable competitive advantage.

Valuable: ExxonMobil's valuable assets include its extensive experience in the oil and gas industry, its R&D capabilities, its technologically sophisticated infrastructure, and its skilled workforce. These assets are valuable because they enable the business to operate efficiently, reduce production costs, and develop innovative market solutions.

In addition, the investment in R&D, innovation, and technology makes ExxonMobil's resources more difficult for rivals to replicate or replace.

Conclusively, ExxonMobil's resources  meet the criteria of being valuable, scarce, inimitable, non-replaceable, and organized.

SWOT Analysis

ExxonMobil's significant investment in R&D enables the company to develop cutting-edge technologies and maintain a competitive edge in a market that is swiftly evolving (Ismail et al., 2020).

Weaknesses: ExxonMobil has limited exposure to Sudan's unique political, cultural, and economic environment, which could hinder its understanding of the market's dynamics and increase market entry risks.
ExxonMobil's primary operations are predominately centered on conventional oil and gas production, making it susceptible to potential changes in global energy demand and regulatory shifts toward renewable energy (EIA, 2019).

Opportunities: Expansion of partnership opportunities The political and economic conditions in Sudan present ExxonMobil with opportunities to form strategic partnerships with local firms and governments, thereby facilitating market entry and mitigating risk (Petersen & Karuppah, 2020). Untapped resources: Sudan's significant untapped oil and gas reserves offer ExxonMobil the opportunity for substantial growth and expansion (OPEC, 2020).

Threats: ExxonMobil faces intense competition from well-established entities such as PetroChina, India's Oil and Natural Gas Corporation, and Malaysia's Petronas, who all have a significant presence in the Sudanese market (Sudan Tribune, 2019). Sudan's volatile political climate and economic struggles create an uncertain environment for ExxonMobil, jeopardizing the company's operations and profitability.






ANALYSIS OF STRATEGIC CHOICES

Evaluation of ExxonMobil’s Current Internationalization Strategy

ExxonMobil has instituted a progressive internationalization strategy by expanding its operations in a variety of nations to capitalize on the oil and gas resources present there. The company enters new markets through a variety of strategies, including greenfield investments, strategic alliances, mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships. According to Hardley et al. (2019), ExxonMobil is able to penetrate its target markets by utilizing an array of risk-mitigation and resource-securing strategies.

The fact that ExxonMobil's strategy has been successful in other markets is not necessarily indicative of its success in Sudan. For instance, ExxonMobil's ability to operate effectively may be significantly impacted by the unstable political climate in Sudan and the continuation of sanctions (Hanisch, 2020). Consequently, it is essential to execute a comprehensive analysis of the company's internationalization strategy in order to tailor its approach to the specific conditions of Sudan.

Analysis of Competitor Strategies in Sudan’s Oil and Gas Market

To identify best practices for market entry, ExxonMobil must consider competitor strategies in the Sudanese oil and gas market. Despite the challenges, several international oil companies (IOCs) have successfully navigated Sudan’s market. For example, China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), Malaysia’s Petronas, and India’s ONGC Videsh have all established a strong presence in Sudan (Ross, 2021). These companies have entered the market primarily through joint ventures and production-sharing contracts with Sudan’s government (Ovadia, 2018).

A joint venture strategy allows IOCs to share risks with local partners while gaining access to vital resources and local knowledge. Partnering with the Sudanese government also fosters goodwill and ensures regulatory compliance (Matar & Bauer, 2021). By studying competitor strategies, ExxonMobil can derive insights into the most viable market entry options and potential pitfalls to avoid.

Value Proposition for Internationalization Initiative in Sudan

ExxonMobil’s value proposition for entering Sudan’s oil and gas market can be built upon three key aspects: resource efficiency, technology and innovation, and environmental and social sustainability (Håvardsson et al., 2020). ExxonMobil’s value proposition in Sudan focuses on leveraging its already well-established expertise and strong brand reputation within the global oil and gas industry (Kumar & Pani, 2013). These elements will position the company to offer superior value to customers compared to existing competitors.

First, ExxonMobil can leverage its expertise in resource management to improve oil recovery and reduce production costs. This efficiency will result in more affordable and widely accessible oil production for Sudan, a key factor in driving economic growth (EIA, 2021).

Second, ExxonMobil’s advanced technologies and innovation practices can enable the company to tackle complex oil and gas projects. For example, ExxonMobil’s proprietary seismic imaging technology helps identify hydrocarbon reservoirs deep beneath the earth’s surface (ExxonMobil, 2021). This technology can enhance exploration efforts in Sudan, where undeveloped reserves offer untapped potential (Ovadia, 2018).

Finally, ExxonMobil should prioritize environmental and social sustainability to differentiate itself from competitors. Companies operating in Sudan have faced criticism for their environmental and human rights records (Matar & Bauer, 2021). ExxonMobil can set itself apart by implementing robust environmental risk management practices and supporting local communities through social investment programs (Hartley & Al, 2019).

In conclusion, ExxonMobil’s current internationalization strategy provides a useful benchmark for its expansion into Sudan. However, the company must carefully tailor its approach based on the unique challenges and opportunities in the Sudanese market. A thorough analysis of competitor strategies will allow ExxonMobil to make informed decisions about the most viable market entry options, while crafting a compelling value proposition will help differentiate the company from existing players.

Analysis of Generic Strategies and Potential Differentiation from Competitors

Michael Porter's (1985) framework for generic strategies is used here to evaluate the various strategies ExxonMobil could employ in Sudan. According to Porter (1985), ExxonMobil has three prospective strategic options from which to choose. These alternatives include cost leadership, differentiation, and concentration. Considering the significance of innovation and proprietary technology in the oil and gas industry, the situation in Sudan appears best adapted for a differentiation strategy (Abokor, 2021).

ExxonMobil's internationalization initiative in Sudan can be viewed as a probable source of market and resource-related synergies (Iansiti & Levien, 2004). How Chosen Strategy Can Be Implemented in Sudan

Based on the analysis of ExxonMobil’s current internationalization approach, competitor strategies, and the value proposition for entering the Sudanese market, a joint venture strategy with the Sudanese government, through Sudapet, the national oil company, emerges as the most viable option. Additionally, collaborating with the government may provide goodwill, facilitating smoother operations in the unstable political climate (Hänisch, 2020).

To implement this joint venture strategy, ExxonMobil should first establish a negotiation and partnership team comprising experts in oil and gas, legal, and finance. This team will be responsible for conducting research, identifying potential Sudanese partners, assessing risks, and negotiating terms of the joint venture agreement (Brouthers et al., 2016). ExxonMobil should also engage at the governmental level to demonstrate commitment to the Sudanese government’s priorities, such as growth, energy security, and domestic value creation (Matar & Bauer, 2021).

Upon establishing the joint venture, ExxonMobil should prioritize capacity building by investing in local talent and infrastructure. Practices such as hiring local workers, providing training programs, and investing in educational initiatives will not only foster goodwill and contribute to the economic development of the country but also provide access to local expertise and reduce the reliance on expatriate workers (Gupta et al., 2021). Operating in Sudan presents several unique challenges for ExxonMobil, including political instability, regulatory compliance, geopolitical risks, and local content requirements. In conclusion, implementing the proposed joint venture strategy in Sudan involves addressing a range of challenges, including political instability, regulatory compliance, geopolitical risks, and local content requirements. ExxonMobil can navigate these obstacles by investing in capacity building, engaging with the Sudanese government and local stakeholders, maintaining compliance with regulations, and adopting proactive risk management strategies.

ExxonMobil's internationalization strategy into Sudan must examine the best entry method. So far, ExxonMobil's growth into Sudan is best done through a joint venture (JV). Joint ventures have many advantages, but ExxonMobil's Sudan partnership is risky. The organization must manage and reduce many risks to ensure project success.

Sudan's political and regulatory problems are ExxonMobil's biggest concerns. Foreign investors worry about frequent policy and regulatory changes due to political instability (EIA, 2021). To negotiate the political landscape and comply with local regulations, ExxonMobil must build good relationships with local stakeholders, including government officials, regulatory bodies, and community leaders.

Infrastructure and logistical issues pose operational hazards. Sudan's oil and gas infrastructure lacks transportation and support (EIA, 2021). ExxonMobil can reduce these risks by working with local groups that can handle these issues and investing in local infrastructure alongside other industry players.

Currency volatility and economic instability also threaten ExxonMobil's Sudan profits and investment returns. To protect its investments against currency and economic changes, the corporation needs strong financial management and hedging methods (Madura, 2017).

Finally, multinationals entering new markets face cultural disparities. To build stakeholder confidence and collaboration in Sudan, ExxonMobil must respect local values, culture, and customs. In conclusion, ExxonMobil's internationalization plan in Sudan needs careful assessment of entry mode and proactive mitigation of market risks. To guarantee long-term success in Sudan, the corporation must actively manage recognized risks through strong stakeholder interactions, investments in local infrastructure, financial management methods, and cultural adaptability.

Cyberpunk visuals often incorporate a futuristic, gritty, and neon aesthetic, presenting a dystopian vision of the future. Here's a brief guide to help you design one:

### Color Scheme
- **Dominant Neons:** Bright neon colors, especially blues, pinks, and purples, against darker, muted backgrounds create a stark, vibrant contrast that's iconic to the cyberpunk aesthetic.
- **Metallic Accents:** Silvers and chromes can provide a high-tech feel, suggesting advanced technology and urban landscapes.

### Key Elements and Imagery
- **Futuristic Cityscapes:** Think dense, vertical cities with towering skyscrapers, megastructures, and flying vehicles. Adding layers of details like holographic signs, neon billboards, and dense fog or smog can deepen the sense of a bustling, overcrowded future.
- **Digital and Analog Fusion:** Displaying a mix of advanced technologies (like cybernetic enhancements, advanced computer interfaces) with retro or decayed urban elements emphasizes the cyberpunk theme of technological advancement outpacing social progress.
- **Characters:** Portraying characters with cybernetic enhancements, wearing urban, futuristic fashion, or posing mysteriously can add a dynamic element. Think about incorporating visors, neon tattoos, or tech-gear.
- **Rain and Reflections:** Rain-soaked streets reflecting neon lights can create a moody atmosphere, perfect for a cyberpunk setting. This also suggests a perennially dark, possibly polluted world.

### Composition Tips
- **Layering:** To create depth, layer different elements of your cityscape or scene. Foreground elements could include characters or street-level details, mid-ground elements could be the bustling city, and the background might feature towering skyscrapers, a moon, or a polluted skyline.
- **Light and Shadow:** Playing with the contrasts between the bright neon lights and the shadows can create a sense of mystery and depth, enhancing the cyberpunk feel.
- **Perspective:** Using a low-angle shot makes the cityscape feel more imposing and monumental, adding to the dystopian vibe.

### Creating the Wallpaper
- **Software Options:** If you are undertaking the design yourself, software like Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or free alternatives like GIMP and Krita could be useful.
- **Stock Elements:** Websites like Unsplash or Pixabay offer free stock photos that could work as base layers or backgrounds. Photoshop brushes and pre-made assets can help add cyberpunk elements like neon signs and futuristic interfaces.
- **Learning and Tutorials:** Plenty of tutorials online can guide you through creating cyberpunk art, from beginner to advanced levels. Look for specific tutorials on YouTube or through digital art platforms like DeviantArt.

Creating a cyberpunk wallpaper is an exciting project that allows for creativity and experimentation. Whether you're doing it yourself or directing an artist, immersion in the cyberpunk ethos and aesthetic can result in a striking piece of art.

Did they now? That was one weird night. I still reckon they slipped me something. Hypnosis, pffft.

LAUREN
(leaning forward, smirking)
Come on, Dave. You know we didn't. Admit it, I just got into your head.

Vicky wiggles her toes, enjoying the flicker of uncertainty in Dave's eyes, while Ruth watches her brother, both a little nervous and incredibly curious.

VICKY
(teasingly)
Who would've thought? Big, strong Dave, completely at our mercy.

Dave lets out a good-natured laugh, shaking his head, still not entirely convinced of the power they claim to have had over him.

DAVE
(playing along)
Alright, then, hypnotist. If you're so sure of yourself, why don't you give it another shot? Ruthie will keep you honest.

Ruth leans in eagerly, her gaze bouncing between Lauren and her brother. The challenge hangs in the air, a playful dare that none of them are willing to back down from.

LAUREN
(smirking)
Challenge accepted. Just relax, Dave. Just like last time.

Lauren stands up, positioning herself in front of Dave, taking on the role of amateur hypnotist with a confidence that belies the years since her last attempt. She locks eyes with him, her voice dropping into a soothing, rhythmic cadence.

LAUREN
(softly)
Focus on my voice, Dave. Just listen and relax... that's right. Your eyelids are getting heavy, your body is feeling warm and light...

Dave's friends from across the bar watch with growing interest, whispering to one another as the scene unfolds. Dave initially keeps a skeptical smile on his face, humoring Lauren, but as she continues, his expression gradually softens.

LAUREN
(deepening her voice gently)
You're feeling calm, Dave. Trust my voice, let it guide you... deeper and deeper into relaxation.

VICKY
(whispers to Ruth)
Watch his eyes. That's where you'll see it happen.

Ruth bites her lip, her heart pounding as she observes the subtle changes in her brother. Dave's resistance seems to be fading, his analytical guard lowering under the weight of Lauren's insistent, gentle voice.

DAVE
(murmuring)
Ruthie... you're seeing this, right?

RUTH
(fascinated)
I... yeah, I'm watching. You said it yourself; let's keep her honest.

LAUREN
You're doing so well, Dave. Just let go. We're all friends here... there's nothing to remember but calmness and obedience...

Dave's smile has vanished, replaced by a loose, relaxed jaw and slightly parted lips. His head begins to nod forward, his eyes fluttering.

VICKY
(quiet triumph in her voice)
Just like last time, he's going under.

Lauren continues, her voice a silky thread winding through Dave's consciousness, drawing him back into that pliable state of total obedient blankness he once found himself in. Ruth can only watch in stunned silence, the reality of her brother's susceptibility becoming undeniably clear.

LAUREN
When I snap my fingers, you'll be completely under, ready to serve your friends just like the good old days... Ready?

With bated breath, the entire table waits for Lauren's snap. With a single crisp motion, her fingers connect, and Dave's posture shifts into one of passive readiness.

LAUREN
(satisfied)
Perfect. Dave, when you wake up, you'll feel the irresistible urge to give us all a foot massage, just like you used to. You won't remember doing it tomorrow either.

The bar fades out of focus around them as Dave wordlessly slips off his chair, his movements slow, automatic, the very image of compliance that both amuses and astonishes his audience, especially his sister.

FADE OUT.

steps:
assistant: INT. JANE'S BEDROOM - DAY

Jane, Sam, and Aaron are sitting on Jane's bed, chatting and laughing together.

AARON
(trying to hide his excitement)
Hey, guys, guess what? I've got something to tell you both.

JANE
(rushing with excitement)
What is it, Aaron? Don't keep us in suspense!

SAM
(giggling)
Yeah, spill the beans, Aaron.

Aaron takes a deep breath and looks at both of them, grinning from ear to ear.

AARON
I'm dating someone. Her name is Chloe.

Jane and Sam exchange glances and burst into excited exclamations.

JANE
(surprised)
Oh my gosh, Aaron! That's incredible news! How did it happen? Tell us everything!

SAM
(giggling)
Yeah, spill the juicy details, Aaron!

Aaron blushes and scratches his head, feeling a bit shy.

AARON
Well, it started a few weeks ago. Chloe and I got paired up for a science project, and we hit it off instantly. We had so much fun working together, and then we hung out more after school. One thing led to another, and now we're officially boyfriend and girlfriend.

JANE
(excitedly)
Aww, that's so sweet, Aaron! I'm really happy for you.

SAM
(teasing)
I knew it! I saw you two spending a lot of time together, but I never expected this. Congrats, Aaron!

Aaron's smile widens, pleased with their positive reactions.

AARON
Thanks, guys! Chloe is really amazing. She's funny, smart, and super supportive. I couldn't ask for a better girlfriend.

JANE
(nudges Aaron playfully)
Just remember, Aaron, you're officially entering the "couples club" now. Welcome to the party!

They all laugh together, enjoying the moment of happiness and friendship.

SAM
(excitedly)
Oh, Aaron, you have to introduce us to Chloe sometime. We could all go on a double date!

JANE
(nods enthusiastically)
Definitely! It'll be so much fun. We'll plan something for next week.

AARON
(sincerely)
Thanks, guys. I'm glad I have such supportive friends. And yes, I would love for all of us to hang out together.

They share a group hug, their bond growing stronger as they embark on this new chapter of their teenage lives.

FADE OUT.

The Ultimate Guide To World-Building: How To Write Fantasy, Sci-Fi And Real-Life Worlds
Written by Claire Bradshaw
in Fiction Writing
World-building is so much more than just a framing device. It’s the very essence of any good fantasy or science fiction story, and the basis of a sense of place in other genres.
Good world-building lends an immersive richness to your writing, while also giving readers the information they need to understand characters and plot lines.
Table Of Contents
So, how exactly should writers go about building worlds in their fiction? To find out, we’ll break down the concept of world-building into three main categories:
Imaginary worlds – the construction of entirely fictional universes, found primarily in fantasy genres.
Alternate reality – re-imaginings of the details of our existing world; popular with writers of science fiction.
Actual locations – the invocation of a real place in the world, utilised in novels with no elements of the fantastic.
Let’s begin by entering the wondrous realm of fantasy fiction.

IMAGINARY WORLDS
Creating an imaginary world is one of the most complex types of world-building. It’s most often utilised in fantasy and science fiction, where a writer conjures up from scratch every detail of a world: geography, history, language, lore, characters, social customs, politics, religion…
Understandably, the thought of creating all these elements to form an entire fictional world can be very daunting – and deciding where to start can seem almost impossible!
For inspiration, we recommend turning to some of the great world-builders of our time to see how they’ve built up whole universes from nothing.
Deciding on a starting point
J. R. R. Tolkien, author of Lord of the Rings, The Hobbit and countless other classic works, began the development of Middle-earth in an unusual way: by first creating an entire fictional language to be spoken by his characters. A professional philologist and talented linguist, Tolkien developed the Elvish language of Quenya, using it as a base for expanding his imaginary world into the vast, detailed, lore-rich Middle-earth we know today.
Of course, not all writers will be capable of (or interested in) creating a functional, fictional language – but budding world-builders can still follow Tolkien’s lead in order to get started.
By pinpointing one aspect of your imaginary world that you’re most interested in or most apt at developing, you’ve got yourself a great starting point.
Work hard on this element first, and then concentrate on building up and fleshing out from there.
You’ll find that the pieces of your world fall much more easily into place once you have a solid foundation from which to expand.
Rivendell, home of the elves in Tolkien’s Middle-earth.

Asking questions about your world
After you’ve got the ball rolling by establishing a starting point, you’ll need to begin working out the details that make up a convincing, consistent imaginary world.
A great way to start doing this is to ask (and answer) a set of questions pertaining to the different aspects of your world.
Approach this exercise as if you were describing your home country to someone who knows nothing about it – or, on a larger scale, as if you were introducing Earth to someone from an alien race. How would you explain:
What it looks and feels like – its landscapes, its climate?
Its people – their appearance, customs, ethics and values?
The dominant forces that shape change and development?
If you’re feeling overwhelmed by all the potential details you need to cover, it’s advisable to start by creating a list of fundamental questions you need to answer about your world.
Many online resources, such as this list from the Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers of America website, contain suggested questions about everything from social organisation and government to the rules of magic and technology.
(The latter of these is particularly important to keep in mind. Even though your world may be an entirely imaginary one filled with magic or made-up technology, it must still be governed consistently and carefully by the internal logic and laws you set up for it.
Its fantastical nature cannot be used as an excuse for lapses in continuity.)
After devising your list, you may feel even more overwhelmed now you have such an expansive range of questions to answer!
If this is the case, take a step back and make sure that all the questions you’ve listed really need to be covered.
It’s likely that some questions may not apply to or directly affect your characters and narrative, so decide which aspects are most crucial to the stories you want to tell within your world, and focus on answering the most relevant questions.
While you’re answering these world-building questions largely for the benefit of your readers, it’s imperative to keep in mind the age-old advice about showing, not telling.
You don’t want readers to feel like they’re simply being spoon-fed a bunch of facts, details and history.
The most successful storytelling comes from a subtle, nuanced approach to building your world through narrative detail, description and development.
Map of the realms of Middle-earth, as imagined by Tolkien.
Drawing inspiration from real life
Even though imagining an entirely new world is one of the most creative processes a writer can undertake, it’s almost impossible to create something entirely from nothing.
Naturally – even if only subconsciously – you will adapt and incorporate some real-world elements into your imaginary setting and story, using them as a base of inspiration.
A well-known fantasy epic with strong undertones of historical influence is George R. R. Martin’s series, A Song of Ice and Fire.
Martin openly acknowledges the fact that many elements of ASOIAF are inspired by real historical events and locations: the Wars of the Roses, the Glencoe Massacre and Hadrian’s Wall, to name just a few.
If you feel your world is lacking in depth or credibility, perhaps take a leaf from Mr. Martin’s (extremely long) book and delve into some real-world history for inspiration.
You may be able to flesh out your world by moulding, adapting or drawing parallels with real-life locations, landmarks, pivotal events, or even historical personalities.
The sprawling city of Meereen from George R. R. Martin’s ‘A Song of Ice and Fire’.
Where reality and fantasy collide
An interesting way to provide contrast or conflict within your story is by developing your fictional world alongside, or within, an established location – for example, right here on Earth.
Perhaps the most famous example of this reality/fantasy cross-over is J. K. Rowling’s Harry Potter series, which involves an entirely made-up world of magic that’s hidden away on modern-day Earth.
Harry himself, as the main character from whose point of view the story is presented, is as much a stranger to this world as readers are in the beginning.
We’re introduced firsthand to every person, place, detail and experience right alongside Harry; as he journeys into this magical new world and has his questions answered, so, too, do we as readers.
Harry enters Diagon Alley to explore his magical new world.
As well as adding depth and relatability to your story, such a setting also poses questions about the concept of an alternate reality. Let’s now look at this concept in more detail.
